_how_to_use: Analytics stays OFF until provider AND site_id are both filled in. Supported provider: "goatcounter" (recommended; site_id = your GoatCounter code, e.g. "mtdsoftwarecompare" for https://mtdsoftwarecompare.goatcounter.com). The API token for the private stats dashboard is NEVER stored here: set it as the GOATCOUNTER_TOKEN environment variable when running scripts/stats.py.
